input.goal: Add slugify(text: str) -> str to textutil.py that lowercases text, strips leading and trailing whitespace, replaces contiguous non-alphanumeric characters with single hyphens, and strips leading or trailing hyphens (returning '' for empty or symbol-only input). Add unit tests for slugify in test_textutil.py.
input.additional_context: Single-module standard-library Python package in textutil.py with tests in test_textutil.py. Decompose into a single vertical-slice issue covering both implementation and tests. Keep tests compatible with both `python3 -m unittest -v` (zero external dependencies) and `pytest -q`.
